name: loosen claim_one_due's due bound, so a job due exactly at now is silently skipped
drop finish_scheduled_run's launching guard, so a finish clobbers a cancelled/indeterminate row
drop cancel_pending's pending guard, so cancelling a launching job silently succeeds
old:
"UPDATE scheduled_runs SET status='cancelled', completed_at=? "
                "WHERE id=? AND status='pending'", (now_epoch(), id))
new:
"UPDATE scheduled_runs SET status='cancelled', completed_at=? "
                "WHERE id=?", (now_epoch(), id))

name: reconcile_launching sweeps the wrong status, so a stray 'launching' row is never cleaned up
invert _fire_claimed_job's started check, so a returned failure is recorded as fired
drop claim_specific's pending guard, so run-now re-claims a no-longer-pending job instead of 409ing
old:
"UPDATE scheduled_runs SET status='launching', claimed_at=? "
                "WHERE id=? AND status='pending'", (now_epoch(), id))
new:
"UPDATE scheduled_runs SET status='launching', claimed_at=? "
                "WHERE id=?", (now_epoch(), id))
